experiment.comment: All the specified experimental uncertainties refer approximately to the 1sigma limits based on the previous paper of the authors (https://doi.org/10.1016/j.combustflame.2022.112087).

The smoothed data series were obtained by selecting representative points from the original (raw) data series. The standard deviations of the smoothed data were obtained by linearly interpolating between the standard deviations of the two neighboring original (raw) data points.
The tabulated data were obtained from the authors through personal communication.
